Project overview

Inductra Vaion

A real-time electromagnetic diagnostic instrument. It reads a QMC5883P three-axis magnetometer and three electric-field probe channels through an Arduino Uno, resolves them into magnetic vectors and relative E-field activity, and measures how far each sits from its own environment.

Hardware
RASPBERRY PIHost + server
ARDUINO UNO R3Sensor bridge · USB
QMC5883PMagnetometer @ 0x2C
E-FIELD PROBE3 plates · Uno A0–A2
TINYSA ULTRASpectrum · USB
RTL-SDRIQ receiver · USB
